description: HC-2: a development module the maker uses for experiments, drawing running maps of the MIDI control codes travelling to and from the Eagan Matrix
notes: this module has no knobs, no jacks and no menu of its own; the two maps show the last value of each control code, the upper one for channel 1 and the lower one for channel 16
the maps are cleared whenever a new preset starts loading, and hovering over one names the control code, what it is for and its current value
the maker describes this module as hidden and meant for development rather than for playing
